deletePage.title: Delete your Chardeevari account
deletePage.intro: You can permanently delete your account from the Chardeevari app (Account → Delete account) or right here.

items.personal: Your name, phone number, email and Google sign-in link are erased immediately.
items.saved: Your saved addresses, cart and reviews are deleted.
items.invoices: Invoices for past orders are retained as required by Indian GST law, but are no longer linked to any account.
items.activeOrders: If an order is still being delivered, please wait for it to be delivered or cancel it first.

deletePage.notCustomer: Merchant and admin accounts can't be deleted here. Please contact support at {{phone}}.
deletePage.loginPrompt: Log in with your registered phone number to continue.

deletePanel.title: Delete account
deletePanel.subtitle: Permanently delete your Chardeevari account and personal data.
deletePanel.warning: This cannot be undone. You will be logged out.

items.personal: Your name, phone number, email and Google sign-in link are erased
items.saved: Saved addresses, cart and reviews are deleted
items.invoices: Past order invoices are kept as required by GST law, but are no longer linked to an account

deletePanel.success: Your account and personal data have been deleted.
